title: Tool-heavy refactor with the plan stated in chat

events.content: Split src/parser.rs so the lexer lives in src/lexer.rs and the node types in src/ast.rs.
The split compiles except for a private helper that parser.rs shares with the lexer. Open: make that helper pub(crate), then rerun cargo test.
Keep the public API of the crate unchanged.

goals: public api of the crate unchanged
